🏚️ Housing
MI SB 1124 — Homeless Teens Can Get Healthcare Without Parents' OK

Michigan could allow homeless or runaway youth, aged 14 and older, to access medically necessary health care without parental consent. The bill defines key terms like 'homeless youth' – someone lacking a safe home environment and seeking shelter – and outlines acceptable documentation for verification. ...
